model: lander pilot (PilotFormer, residual on classic ZEM/ZEV guidance)
map: lola5m_site11 (Site11, the pilot's VALIDATION map: used to pick the checkpoint, not a test map)
hazard_belief: slope-rule backup map from sparse laser pixels
selection: first nominal / engine-out-only / nav-drift-only mission among 128 drawn with seed 70311 at config failure rates (not chosen by outcome)
pairing: classic and pilot fly the identical mission: same initial state, failure time, drift vector and sensor-noise seed
command: thrust command in [-1,1] per axis (x east, y north, z up) as a fraction of total max thrust; final = clip(classic + 0.3 * authority * clip(residual_raw)); authority = 1 (no rule in this checkpoint); pilot re-plans every 5 steps (0.5 s)

panels: height relative to lander nadir (cividis, per-image range)
camera.footprint: north-up, centred under the lander, side = clip(altitude + 60 m, 60, 640) m
